# Chaffee Exteriors
Independent exterior-care business serving Fort Smith, Arkansas, Chaffee Crossing, Van Buren, Alma, Greenwood, and Barling.
## Services
- /gutter-cleaning: debris removal, downspout flush, haul-away, photos. Draft starting price $149.
- /gutter-guards: micro-mesh on existing gutters. Draft starting price $599.
- /gutter-repair: leak sealing, re-hanging, re-pitch and downspout repairs. Draft service call $129; repair quote after inspection.
- /soft-wash: house wash from $299 and roof wash from $399 (draft rates).
- /membership: planned recurring care; prices pending.
- /realtors: property-specific quotes; commercial work quote-only.
- /contact: request a visit; appointments require confirmation.
Prices are draft planning values, confirmed on site. Larger scopes need custom review. This preview is not connected to live booking or lead delivery until configured.
